title: Textile passport (textile@3), public payload
description: textile@3: the public payload carried on chain in field 10. JSON Schema validity is one check; obligation under a condition (needs-review), units, provenance and legal applicability are separate checks.

notice.description: The sample marker a demonstration record carries first; never product data.

profile.description: The profile identifier the payload declares.

profile_version.description: The profile version the payload declares; a reader decodes under it and never under a newer one.

object_did.description: An optional physical-object DID carried in the public payload; carrying it does not implement physical binding.

dataCarrier.description: The data-carrier identifier (chip UID) the lookup service indexes beside the passport identifier.

name.title: Product name
name.description: required; ESPR Annex III(a); the passport has to say what the product is

category.title: Kind of product
category.description: required; ESPR Art. 4; the parameters that apply depend on what the product is

modelIdentifier.title: Model or style reference
modelIdentifier.description: required; ESPR Annex III(b): the unique product identifier is model-level

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: required; ESPR Annex III(b); Reg. 1007/2011 traceability of a labelled lot

gtin.title: Article number (GTIN)
gtin.description: recommended; ESPR Annex III(c): commodity and trade item codes where they exist

manufacturer.title: Brand name
manufacturer.description: required; ESPR Annex III(e); Reg. 1007/2011 Art. 15 identifies the responsible operator

manufacturerContact.title: Brand contact
manufacturerContact.description: required; ESPR Annex III(e): the operator has to be reachable, not merely named

manufacturingPlace.title: Where it was made
manufacturingPlace.description: required; Reg. 1007/2011 Art. 16 read with the Union Customs Code origin rules

made.title: Made
made.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(a): a durability claim is meaningless without a start date

colour.title: Colour
colour.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It identifies the item to the person holding it.

size.title: Size
size.description: recommended; Nothing requires this. It is what makes a passport match the garment in hand.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(l): resource use, and the basis of every per-mass figure below

fibres.title: Fibre composition
fibres.description: required; Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Art. 5, 9 and 14: binding today, by weight, in descending order

nonTextileParts.title: Non-textile parts of animal origin
nonTextileParts.description: required; Reg. (EU) 1007/2011 Art. 12: mandatory where such parts are present; applicability needs-review

recycledContent.title: Recycled content
recycledContent.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(g): recycled content is a named parameter; the threshold waits on the act

biobasedContent.title: Bio-based content
biobasedContent.description: optional; Nothing requires this. Declared where a brand can substantiate it.

trims.title: Trims and hardware
trims.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(d) and (n): what separates for repair, and what separates for recycling

substancesOfConcern.title: Substances of concern
substancesOfConcern.description: required; ESPR Art. 7(5): substances of concern must be traceable through the passport; applicability needs-review

substanceStatement.title: What that means for you
substanceStatement.description: recommended; ESPR Art. 9(2)(b): passport information shall be complete and comprehensible

microplasticRelease.title: Microplastic release
microplasticRelease.description: optional; ESPR Annex I(k); the method is not yet fixed

care.title: Care
care.description: required; ISO 3758 care symbols; Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2 on durability information

careNote.title: How to make it last
careNote.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(a): extending lifetime is the parameter; this is how

expectedLifetime.title: Expected lifetime
expectedLifetime.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(a) and Dir. (EU) 2024/825: a durability claim must be substantiated

washCycles.title: Tested to
washCycles.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(b) reliability, tested per ISO 6330 domestic washing procedures

colourFastness.title: Colour fastness
colourFastness.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(b), graded 1-5 per the ISO 105 series

dimensionalStability.title: Dimensional change after washing
dimensionalStability.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(b), measured per ISO 5077

pillingResistance.title: Pilling resistance
pillingResistance.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(b), graded 1-5 per ISO 12945

guarantee.title: Guarantee
guarantee.description: recommended; Dir. (EU) 2024/825: a commercial guarantee of durability must state its term

repairability.title: Repairability
repairability.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(c) and Art. 7(2)(b)(iii)

spareParts.title: Spare parts
spareParts.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(d): availability of spare parts is a named parameter

repairInstructions.title: Repair instructions
repairInstructions.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(e): access to repair information

repairServices.title: Where to get it repaired
repairServices.description: recommended; Dir. (EU) 2024/825 recital 22: repair should be the visible option

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon footprint
carbonFootprint.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(m), computed per the Apparel and Footwear PEFCR

carbonFootprintStudy.title: The study behind the figure
carbonFootprintStudy.description: recommended; ESPR Art. 9(2)(b): a figure a reader cannot check is not information

waterUse.title: Water use
waterUse.description: optional; ESPR Annex I(l): resource use. Declared where a brand has measured it.

collection.title: Where to return it
collection.description: required; Waste Framework Directive: separate collection of textiles since 1 January 2025

recyclability.title: How it can be recycled
recyclability.description: recommended; ESPR Annex I(n): expected generation of waste materials

supplyChain.title: Supply chain
supplyChain.description: recommended; ESPR Annex III(f): unique facility identifiers, at the stages that have them

certifications.title: Independent certification
certifications.description: recommended; Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2: a sustainability label needs a certification behind it

components.title: Components
components.description: recommended; ESPR Annex III and Annex I: composition and evidence at the level of the component the delegated act may name

componentFibres.title: Fibre composition per component
componentFibres.description: recommended; Regulation (EU) 1007/2011 Articles 5, 9 and 14 read per component; ESPR Annex I

recycledContentAssessment.title: Recycled content, assessed
recycledContentAssessment.description: optional; ESPR Annex I(g): recycled content with its method, basis and boundary

certificationEvidence.title: Certification evidence
certificationEvidence.description: optional; Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2: the certification behind a sustainability label, as evidence

relatedDocuments.title: Related documents
relatedDocuments.description: optional; none: documents a value points at, with their access policy and, where retained, their digest

microfibreReleaseAssessment.title: Microfibre release, assessed
microfibreReleaseAssessment.description: optional; ESPR Annex I(k): microplastic and microfibre release, by a named method

repairabilityAssessment.title: Repairability, assessed
repairabilityAssessment.description: optional; ESPR Annex I(c) and Art. 7(2)(b)(iii): a repairability assessment under a named method

warrantyTerms.title: Commercial guarantee terms
warrantyTerms.description: optional; Dir. (EU) 2024/825: a commercial guarantee of durability states its term and what it counts from

careNoteLocalised.title: Care note, by language
careNoteLocalised.description: optional; ESPR Annex I(a): care information as the maker supplied it in each language

substanceStatementLocalised.title: Substance statement, by language
substanceStatementLocalised.description: optional; ESPR Art. 9(2)(b): the substance statement in each language it was supplied in

inapplicableFields.title: Declared inapplicable fields
inapplicableFields.description: optional; none: the profile's own declaration by which a record says that a conditional field does not apply to it, with the reason

datePrecision.description: How precise a date is. A month-precision date is written YYYY-MM and never given a day; a year-precision date is written YYYY.

dateOrDateTime.description: A year, a month, a day or an instant; the precision the shape declares says which is meant.

componentRef.description: The component this evidence covers, when the granularity is component; a component need not have a token.

property.description: The JSON pointer of the field the evidence is about.

reporter.description: Who reported the fact, when that is not the issuer of the source.

reportRef.description: A verification report the evidence was evaluated in.

certification.description: A certificate as evidence. The scheme's homepage and the issuer's signature are inputs to a verification; only verification.status says what was established, and unknown is not a pass.

issuer.description: The certification body or issuer as named on the certificate.

measurement.description: A measured or assessed value with the scope that makes it comparable: the unit, the basis (a fraction is not a percent), the functional unit or denominator, the method and its version, the boundary and conditions, when it was measured and for which subject. A value that is a string carries a basis, because a bare string cannot be compared.

conversion.description: Present only when the value was converted from its source unit under a stated rule; a converted value never loses its source unit.

relatedDocument.description: A document a value points at. A URL is where the document was seen, not a commitment to its content; only retained bytes carry a digest.

localisedText.description: Text in one or more languages as the source supplied it. A reader selects the exact tag, then the base language, then the declared default, and records which; it never rewrites a value as another language.

warrantyTerms.description: A model's warranty terms: a duration and the calendar rule that says what the duration counts from. Terms alone give no expiry.

warrantyExpiry.description: An item's derived warranty expiry: the evidenced start, the terms applied and the derived date at the precision the start permits. A month-precision start yields a month, never an invented day.
